summary.headline: Astrology and the Three Planetary Temperaments
summary.text: A letter argues against citing the astrologer John, accused of iconoclasm, despite his priestly status, meteorological observations, and alleged ending of a famine; it invokes the thirty-sixth canon of the Synod of Laodicea against priestly enchanters and mathematicians. It then explains the astrological physiology of Kronos, Ares, and Zeus, describing their coldness, heat, dryness, and benefic or malefic qualities.
